relations.notes: Soft order for the Meet-a-language path; never a gate.

comparison_policy.notes: Compare the focus language with the learner's best language and every other language they know at C1 or above (INTRO_FACTS.md, Known languages).

experience_blueprint.notes: Stop 2 of the Meet-a-language path, a short visual tour: the writing at a glance, then the symbols new to this learner to tap and hear. The letters themselves are learned in the script lesson, a leaf of this stop.

notes: The letters a learner lacks are computed from two alphabets, never written per language pair. Speech for single letters is unreliable, so spoken examples are whole words.
